ns2:section.sectionText: This re-designed section of LAS 101 will orient first year students to our academic culture and resources available to support their achievement. Students will be introduced to aspects of design-thinking that will help them understand and successfully integrate into our diverse LAS community. They will learn valuable skills like wayfinding and reframing to assist their creative problem-solving throughout their undergraduate experience. Students will be challenged to Inquire, Engage and Create.
